events.text: Nell: Hi Rey, I’ve mostly heard this second-hand, but it sounds like the repair drive is next Saturday at Sam’s garage for small appliances and tools first—do you know what still needs fixing or who needs help?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Rey: That matches what I’ve heard, Nell—small appliances and tools are confirmed, and safety repairs still come first, but I’d rather keep names off any list until folks opt in.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Nell: That makes sense, Rey—I’ll keep it to categories and supplies for now, and only add names if folks tell me directly they want help.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Mara—I’ll keep it quiet and just make a few one-on-one checks about safety repairs until you’ve got the time and rain plan settled.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey, that’s exactly right—just keep it to quiet safety-repair feelers for now, and I’ll circle back once I’ve confirmed the time, drop-off hours, shifts, and rain storage.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Rey: Got it, Mara. I’ll just ask a couple folks privately what feels urgent, and I won’t mention details until you say they’re set.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Hana: Hi Rey, before we move anything forward, can we confirm what’s actually settled for the repair drive—date, place, repair priorities, and which volunteers are definite?
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Rey: What I’ve heard is only that next Saturday at Sam’s garage may be the plan, but I’d treat that as unconfirmed for now. Priorities can stay roof leaks, broken steps, and heating trouble, and I won’t name households until they’ve agreed.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey—that helps. I’ll mark next Saturday at Sam’s garage as tentative, keep those three urgent priorities for now, and wait on any household names until each one agrees.
events.speaker: Hana
